[[b]]What Is a Boom Pump and How Does It Work?[[/b]]
A [[b]]Boom Pump[[/b]] consists of a hydraulic arm mounted on a truck. The arm can extend vertically and horizontally to transport ready-mix concrete from the mixer directly to construction points.
[[b]]Boom Pump Working Process[[/b]]

items: Ready-mix concrete is loaded into the pump hopper.
Hydraulic cylinders push the concrete through delivery pipes.
The boom arm directs concrete to the desired location.
Concrete is placed accurately with minimal manual handling.
Construction progresses faster with consistent output.

blocks.text: This process improves efficiency and reduces the challenges associated with manual transportation methods.
